note: Adjudicated accidental and house-orthography variants. The witnesses agree on the substantive text.

adjudicated.ruling: The lexical accent is restored in the working text under the edition's house convention; the witness's capital typography is recorded exactly.
The approved Benziger printing's punctuation is retained. The difference marks phrasing and does not change the words.

The page prints the repeated antiphon only as a cue (℣. Glória Patri. Oculi.). The reading of witness mr here is the house expansion of that cue under the repetition rule of Rubricae generales 427. Its capital typography is that of the antiphon's first printing at w001, which was checked on the page, and the cue sets the same unaccented capital. Witness do prints the repeated antiphon in full, with the capital unaccented. The lexical accent is restored in the working text under the edition's house convention.
